title.big: FPSO-hull CP design, answered in chat
title.desc: Ask in plain English. Deckhand asks for what it needs, runs the calculation, and sends back a report you can keep.

turns.html: I need a hull-anode CP estimate for an FPSO to ABS offshore guidance — can you run it?

Happy to — a few details so I size it right:
  • External submerged hull area?
  • Water depth (it sets the current-density band)?
  • Design life, and the maximum seawater temperature?
  • Anode type and net unit mass?
This estimates the external hull CP to ABS offshore guidance — current demand over life and the aluminium anode mass.

FPSO hull — 8,000 m² external submerged area, moored in 20 m of water. Tropical site, seawater up to 25 °C, 25-year design life. Aluminium stand-off hull anodes, 180 kg net each, utilisation 0.80. It's in the file.

Got it — external hull in the shallow (0–30 m) band, so I'll run the ABS estimate. Basis I'll use: current densities of 150 / 75 / 100 mA/m² (initial/mean/final), coating breakdown over life, current demand, then aluminium anode mass from the charge. Running it now…

Here's the estimate:
QuantityResultOver lifeBasis
Mean protective current96.0 A12 → 248 AABS
Required anode mass14,091 kg—Al, 1,865 Ah/kg
Tropical FPSO hull, 8,000 m² external. Mean demand 96 A over 25 years, rising to 248 A as the coating breaks down — total aluminium anode mass 14,091 kg (≈ 79 × 180 kg stand-offs, indicative; final layout set by the hull arrangement).

report.title: FPSO-Hull CP Design (ABS offshore guidance)
report.inputs:
Hull
FPSO external submerged area 8,000 m² · water depth 20 m (0–30 m band)

Design & environment
Design life 25 yr · tropical · seawater max 25 °C

Anodes
Al stand-off hull anodes · 180 kg net each · utilisation 0.80
anode capacity 1,865 Ah/kg
report.methodology:
1 · Current densities 150 / 75 / 100 mA/m² (initial / mean / final), ABS shallow-water band.
2 · Coating breakdown over life — initial 0.01 / mean 0.16 / final 0.31.
3 · Current demand = area × density × breakdown.
4 · Aluminium anode mass from total charge (capacity 1,865 Ah/kg, utilisation 0.80).
report.outputs:

Current density (init/mean/final)150 / 75 / 100 mA/m²ABS band

Current demand (init/mean/final)12.0 / 96.0 / 248.0 Aover life
Anode capacity1,865 Ah/kgutilisation 0.80
Required anode mass14,091.2 kgaluminium
Verdict: 14,091 kg of aluminium hull anodes — mean demand 96 A, final 248 A over the 25-year life. Anode count and placement follow from the hull arrangement (≈ 79 × 180 kg indicative).
